basic_info.description: First time on the market in 75 years.  This home served the family well and it's time to allow someone else the thrill of living in San Francisco in this row home they can make their own.  Huge picture window looking mostly south-east allows fabulous sunlight into the home as well as the three skylights throughout the home.  A beautiful, ornate fireplace is the focal point in the living room and the large dining area give the home a lot of spaciousness.  The functional kitchen is well suited for that morning breakfast and the quick meal on the run.  The home sits above the garage and there's an additional bonus room put in years ago for the family as they raised their four daughters.  A deep backyard waits for your green thumb to bring it alive again.  This is an "AS IS", Trust sale of the cherished family home.  Come make it your own and live the City life not too far from San Francisco State University.
